thesis: The episode introduces Chris Abdelmessih, co-founder of Moontower AI, who discusses his career trajectory from market making on the trading floor to relative value trading and his current venture providing a volatility lens for traders. The conversation highlights how his experience in open outcry pits and early adoption of technology shaped his approach to probability, payoff space, and trading in electronic markets.
